jobs.title: Junior Web & Frontend Developer (Diploma Internship)
jobs.educationalQualifications: Diploma in Engineering in Computer Science & Technology (BTEB)
jobs.description: Join Brain Station 23 enterprise web division as a Junior Frontend & React Intern. Selected diploma engineers will work alongside senior architects on production React, TypeScript, and REST API projects with full-time conversion opportunity.
jobs.requirements: Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS/Tailwind, JavaScript/TypeScript, and React.js. Knowledge of REST APIs and Git.

jobs.title: Sub-Assistant Engineer (Telecom & Optical Fiber Network)
jobs.experienceRequirements: 0 to 1 year in NOC, ISP, or Optical Fiber maintenance
jobs.educationalQualifications: 4-Year Diploma in Engineering in Computer, Telecommunication, or Electrical Technology under BTEB
jobs.description: Responsible for monitoring NTTN optical fiber links, configuring Mikrotik/Cisco routers, troubleshooting enterprise client connectivity, and coordinating field maintenance across Dhaka metro.
jobs.requirements: Diploma in Engineering (Computer/Telecom/Electrical). Knowledge of IP Subnetting, Optical Fiber splicing, and Router configuration.

jobs.title: Sub-Assistant Engineer — Hardware & Embedded QA
jobs.stipendOrSalary: BDT 18,000 / month + Subsidized Lunch & Staff Bus
jobs.experienceRequirements: Fresh Diploma graduates or 8th Semester students
jobs.educationalQualifications: Diploma in Engineering in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Technology (Minimum CGPA 3.00)
jobs.description: Perform PCB quality assurance, microcontroller firmware flashing, oscilloscope signal testing, and automated hardware diagnostics at Walton Hi-Tech manufacturing complex.
jobs.requirements: Microprocessor 8086/Microcontroller concepts, PCB schematic reading, and testing lab instruments.

jobs.title: Sub-Assistant Engineer (Civil & Structural Construction)
jobs.experienceRequirements: 1-2 years in residential/commercial site supervision (Freshers with strong AutoCAD skills may apply)
jobs.educationalQualifications: 4-Year Diploma in Civil Engineering or Architecture from any Govt. Polytechnic Institute
jobs.description: Supervise RCC casting, bar schedule verification, site billing, contractor coordination, and AutoCAD structural drawing compliance at ongoing Dhaka residential projects.
jobs.requirements: AutoCAD 2D/3D, estimating & costing, BNBC code familiarity, and site supervision capability.

jobs.title: Sub-Assistant Engineer (PLC & Industrial Automation)
jobs.experienceRequirements: Freshers / 0-1 Year in factory utility or PLC maintenance
jobs.educationalQualifications: Diploma in Engineering (Electrical / Mechanical / Power / Mechatronics)
jobs.description: Maintain automated packaging lines, VFD drives, industrial boilers, 11kV/0.4kV substation switchgear, and preventive maintenance logs.
jobs.requirements: PLC ladder logic basics, 3-phase motor control, star-delta starter troubleshooting, and mechanical utility maintenance.

jobs.title: Junior Network Support Engineer (Expired Listing Sample)
jobs.description: Provide L1/L2 technical support for corporate fiber broadband clients, VLAN tagging, and ONU configuration.
jobs.requirements: TCP/IP, OSI Model, VLANs,MikroTik & Cisco CCNA fundamentals.
